data.company_overview: Postman provides an API platform that enables developers to design, test, manage, and distribute APIs at enterprise scale. It streamlines the entire API lifecycle and facilitates collaboration for faster API development.
data.target_audience: Software developers, engineering teams, and enterprises that build, test, and manage APIs.

data.company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Postgres development platform that provides a full managed database, authentication, realtime, storage, edge functions, and vector embeddings. It enables developers to quickly build and scale applications from prototypes to production.
data.target_audience: Developers and engineering teams building applications, ranging from hobby projects and startups to enterprise and AI-driven solutions.

data.company_overview: Vapi provides a unified platform that enables developers and enterprises to build, deploy, and manage advanced voice AI agents quickly and at scale. The solution includes real‑time monitoring, enterprise‑grade security, and built‑in guardrails to ensure reliable, compliant voice interactions.
data.target_audience: Enterprises and developers building voice AI agents and conversational telephony solutions.
